name: James Dillingham Young
summary: Della's husband, young, thin and serious, who works for twenty dollars a week.
personality: Quiet and steady; keeps his feelings to himself.
background: Once paid thirty dollars a week; now twenty. Owns a gold watch that was his father's and grandfather's.
appearance: Thin and serious; needs a new overcoat; has no gloves.

start.inner_state: Wants to give Della something for Christmas.
